header.title: Our Cookbook & Recipe World
header.subtitle: Import recipes from Pinterest, Chefkoch and many other sites, collect them together and cook step by step.

card.addIngredientsTitle: Add ingredients to the shopping list

tandoor.title: Import from Tandoor Recipes
tandoor.description: Imports the official Tandoor export including ingredients, steps and available images.
tandoor.hint: In Tandoor: open a recipe → menu → export → select all recipes. Then choose the ZIP file here.

rtk.title: Import from My Recipe Box
rtk.description: Imports a complete .rtk backup including ingredients, instructions, images and source links.
rtk.hint: In My Recipe Box: Sync/Backup → Export backup (RTK). On Android, you can then send the RTK file directly via Share → LX Family.

import.shareArrivalBody: LX picks up the link. Social media recipes open as a reviewable draft first.
import.shareRtkArrivalBody: LX is reading the shared RTK file and importing its recipes together with any available images.
import.title: Import a recipe from the web
import.description: Paste a recipe link, Pinterest pin or public Facebook Reel. Social media content is always opened for review before saving.
import.howto: No copying needed on Android: Install LX as an app once. Then import from recipe sites, Pinterest or Facebook via Share → LX Familie.
import.socialTextSummary: Useful when Facebook only shares the link
import.socialTextLabel: Caption or recipe text from the Reel
import.socialTextPlaceholder: Paste the title, ingredients and method from the Reel caption …
import.socialTextHint: The text stays on your LX server and opens as an editable draft.
import.help: Private pages, logins and internal home network addresses are not opened for security reasons. Some sites may technically block automatic retrieval.

review.title: Review once, then save
review.description: Reel captions can omit quantities, ordering or individual steps. Add anything missing below.
review.sharedDescription: Other recipe apps share different amounts of detail depending on their version. Quickly review quantities and order, and add an image if needed.
